lesson.smiling_sun.title: Smiling Sun
lesson.smiling_sun.summary: Trace and draw a bright sun from one big circle, simple rays and a happy face.
lesson.smiling_sun.step.sun_shape: Start with one big round sun shape. Follow the path slowly and meet where you started.
lesson.smiling_sun.help.sun_shape_hint: Imagine drawing around a big orange sitting in the sky.
lesson.smiling_sun.step.rays: Now add short rays around the sun, like little beams reaching out.
lesson.smiling_sun.step.happy_face: Add two tiny eyes and a gentle smile to make your sun friendly.
lesson.smiling_sun.help.face_hint: Keep the eyes near the same height, then place the smile underneath.
lesson.smiling_sun.complete.drawing: Wonderful! You turned simple lines and a circle into a smiling sun.
